title: StellCoilBench 合作榜单预览
cohort_semantics: current/legacy identify the declared current selected references and legacy default reference sets. Retained candidates may originate from either historical recipe when paired physics is compatible; these are not two isolated original-agent campaigns.
scope: 10 surfaces x 2 reference cohorts. Selected retained designs with complete paired evidence; not an exhaustive leaderboard or an accepted official ranking.
warnings: 设计成绩榜与agent预算对照分开。
不能将两组榜中的同一几何算作独立成功。
硬通过与九软全过分开显示。
未评价或协议不符不填0、不判输赢。
公开网页缓存分数不替代双方同协议复算。
